record.paper_title: Some open problems related to small divisors
record.original_question: Show that any generic analytic one-parameter family of linear quasiperiodic skew-product systems that is sufficiently close to constant coefficients is reducible for almost every parameter value.

evidence.quote: Problem 4.1 (L.H. Eliasson) [Ell, El2] Show that any generic analytic one-pammeter family of skew-systems sufficiently close to constant coeffi­ cients is reducible for almost every parameter value.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\omega \in \mathbb{R}^d$ be a fixed Diophantine frequency vector, and consider one-parameter families $\{A_\lambda\}_{\lambda \in I}$ (with $I \subset \mathbb{R}$ a parameter interval) of analytic maps $A_\lambda : \mathbb{T}^d \to G$, where $G$ is a (semisimple) matrix Lie group such as $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$, $SU(2)$, or more generally a compact or noncompact reductive group. To each $A_\lambda$ one associates the linear quasiperiodic skew-product (cocycle) on $\mathbb{T}^d \times \mathbb{C}^n$ defined by
$$ (\theta, v) \longmapsto (\theta + \omega, \; A_\lambda(\theta) v). $$
Such a cocycle is called reducible if there exists an analytic map $B : \mathbb{T}^d \to G$ (possibly on a double cover) and a constant matrix $C \in G$ such that
$$ B(\theta + \omega)^{-1} A_\lambda(\theta) B(\theta) = C \quad \text{for all } \theta \in \mathbb{T}^d. $$
Assume the family $\lambda \mapsto A_\lambda$ is analytic and sufficiently close to a constant family (i.e., $A_\lambda(\theta)$ is uniformly close to a $\theta$-independent matrix on a complex neighborhood of $\mathbb{T}^d$).

Prove that for a generic such analytic one-parameter family that is sufficiently close to constant coefficients, the cocycle defined by $A_\lambda$ is reducible for Lebesgue-almost every parameter $\lambda \in I$.
artifact.status_search_result: The full statement, asking for almost-everywhere reducibility along generic analytic one-parameter families near constant coefficients in arbitrary Lie groups, remains a guiding conjecture in the area. Substantial partial results are known: Eliasson proved reducibility for a positive-measure set of parameters for Diophantine frequencies and cocycles close to constant; Avila established the Almost Reducibility Conjecture for one-frequency analytic SL(2,R) cocycles, and various extensions (Gevrey classes, finitely differentiable cocycles, nonperturbative versions by Hou–You and others) have been obtained. However, the general genericity and a.e.-reducibility statement in the form posed has not been fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: A Nonperturbative Eliasson's Reducibility Theorem
status_evidence.snippet: reducible for almost all values of the energy, partial nonperturbative generalization of a reducibility theorem by Eliasson.
status_evidence.claim: Partial reducibility results generalizing Eliasson's theorem are known.

status_evidence.title: On the almost reducibility conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: The Almost Reducibility Conjecture establishes that one-frequency analytic SL(2,R) cocycles are almost reducible.
status_evidence.claim: The Almost Reducibility Conjecture has been established in the one-frequency analytic SL(2,R) setting.

status_evidence.title: Strong almost reducibility for analytic and Gevrey quasi-periodic cocycles
status_evidence.snippet: Strong version of almost reducibility for analytic and Gevrey cocycles.
status_evidence.claim: Strong almost-reducibility versions are known in analytic and Gevrey classes.
